mapper.select: SELECT * FROM passenger_ai_conversation WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND active_request_no IS NOT NULL AND (active_request_started_at IS NULL OR active_request_started_at < #{cutoff}) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE passenger_ai_conversation SET status = 'DELETED', active_request_no = NULL, active_request_started_at = NULL, delete_reason = 'USER_DELETE', deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1, updated_at = #{deletedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND row_version = #{expectedRowVersion} AND deleted_at IS NULL
